card_text: Planning a skin fade from Hobbs: the drive, the upkeep and how to book it.

seo.title: Skin Fade for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Skin fades for Hobbs clients, cut in Carlsbad about 80 minutes west on US 62/180. How to plan the upkeep around the drive, and how to book on Booksy.

paragraphs: A skin fade runs the sides and back down to bare skin and blends up into the length on top. I cut them in Carlsbad, {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles west of Hobbs on {{city:hobbs.route}}, so from Hobbs this is a planned trip of about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes each way.
Here's how to book it, how to time the regrowth around that drive, and what to ask for when you sit down.

blocks.heading: Book the next one before you head home.
paragraphs: Bare skin is where regrowth shows first, so this cut softens sooner than most. From Hobbs every touch-up means another {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}}-mile drive, so it helps to grab your next time on Booksy while you're still in Carlsbad.
How long you go between visits is your call. Some people want it razor sharp every time; others don't mind the grown-in stage for a while.

blocks.heading: Short sides for a long summer.
paragraphs: Hobbs averages a July high of {{city:hobbs.july_high_f}}, with about {{city:hobbs.days_100f}} days a year at 100°F or more (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). Taking the sides down to skin leaves less hair to hold that heat, which is why some people switch to a skin fade when summer comes.

blocks.heading: Two ways to book it.
blocks.lead: Prices and times from my Booksy menu.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The fade and the top, finished with a razor-clean neckline. Right for a clean-shaven face.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: The fade plus your beard, trimmed or lined up, with a hot towel at the end. Book this one if the beard stays.

items.q: How far do I drive from Hobbs for a skin fade?
items.a: About {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles, or roughly {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes west on {{city:hobbs.route}}, to {{address}}.

items.q: Essential Haircut or Signature Cut for a skin fade?
items.a: Essential if you keep your face clean-shaven, Signature if you want your beard done in the same visit.

items.a: The skin fade page shows cuts from my chair, front and back.
